# Handoff notes

## Initial snapshot

Prepared on 4 October 2026 from the approved RWA News Today ecosystem components and data. Original source revision: `9bebc1a5c8464619ebd63dcd6077cd71b2598501`. The new repository starts with fresh Git history.

Included:

- 831 canonical profiles, with 844 category placements.
- 692 current profiles and 139 historical initiatives.
- 780 referenced local logo files; 50 profiles have no bundled logo.
- Current categories and the horizontal tokenization section.
- Company descriptions, optional websites, lifecycle notes, related initiatives, news matching metadata and 18 curated official-update references.
- Profile drawer, local asset rendering and an optional recipient-owned news adapter.

Excluded:

- RWA News credentials, database connection, news collector and ingestion workflows.
- Jobs, token prices, general news feed and private review/research dashboards.
- Original repository history, local environment files and unused logo assets.

## Independence and updates

The map is functional without a backend. The optional feed belongs to the recipient. Directory updates are separate from article ingestion and are not automatically synchronized with the original product.

Counts reflect this snapshot, not a promise that each current initiative is continuously monitored. Existing review dates and historical scope notes are retained.

## Attribution and permissions

The directory was curated by Ray Buckton / RWA News Today from the existing company list, RWA World, RWA.io and company references. Company names and logo assets remain associated with their respective owners. This private handoff does not add an open-source license or grant broader rights to third-party assets. Keep source attribution when sharing a derived directory.

No collaborator invitations, paid services, deployments or recurring GitHub Actions workflows are enabled by this package.
